arms.candidate: same base + adapter trained on verified fit-split repairs only
arms.deterministic_random: same base + adapter trained on an equal number of unverified fit-split attempts (pool-matched, includes failing ones)
arms.fixed_policy: same base, k=4 verified fit repairs retrieved by module similarity as few-shot, no training

decision_rule: Pass iff candidate minus each of the three other arms has paired-bootstrap 95% lower bound >= min_effect_micro/2 and mean >= min_effect_micro, in at least 2 of 3 seeds, retention holds. Fail if any contrast mean < 0 or retention breaks. Otherwise Inconclusive (never positive). n_assess is small, so Inconclusive is the expected outcome unless the effect is large; per_module may be raised only in a NEW experiment id.
domain: this repository, caduceus/*.py injected-bug repair; oracle = covering unittest modules green, only the target file changed
falsifier: if the pool-matched unverified adapter matches the verified one (difference lower bound <= 0), verification added nothing and the recursion thesis is not supported in this domain
hypothesis: A LoRA adapter trained only on verified repairs of fit-split bugs (repair passes the module's tests) raises the repair pass rate on sealed assess-split bugs by at least 0.10 versus the untouched base, a fixed retrieval policy (same verified fit repairs as few-shot examples, no training), AND a pool-matched adapter trained on the same number of unverified attempts. Assess-split modules are disjoint from fit and tune modules.
known_limits: single domain and single base model; replication in a second model is a separate experiment
same base model and proposer as exp-008; only data volume and split changed
leakage_controls: assess tasks never rendered to any proposer or trainer
mutated assess sources not written to disk; regenerated at eval time from (module, op, ordinal)
tests directory unwritable by repair (verifier refuses other files)
oracle_audit: tasks/bugtasks-v1.audited.json (mutant kill rate by operator); survivors are what the oracle cannot see and bound the claim
post_lock_changes: runner carries the exp-008 post-lock fixes from the start (tolerant parser, one-shot prompt, indentation-tolerant apply, K=12).
recursion_next: exp-009 round 2 is allowed only if this is a Pass; its data is generated by the round-1 admitted adapter on a new split_seed
retention: tune-split pass rate must not drop for the candidate versus untouched_base by more than 0.02 (the earlier 30-task protected set was dropped before lock: no generation path for it)
round_policy: Round 2 of at most 3 (exp-008-bugrepair-round1 Failed and is closed; exp-010, exp-011 are the only others permitted). Any claim from this series must report the number of rounds run. Each round has a new id, split seed, manifest and lock; thresholds are not retuned.
status: Locked by ledger entry in ledgers/exp-009-bugrepair.jsonl before any model run.
training_floor: training runs only if >=30 distinct verified fit repairs exist (<=2 per task); otherwise the round is recorded NotRun, not Fail.
unit: assess task, one attempt per arm per seed
